Lemon Garlic Butter Chicken Spiedini
Air-Fried Breaded Chicken Skewers
Prep Time: 15 minutes
Cook Time: 15 minutes
Marinating Time: 30–60 minutes
Total Time: Approximately 1–1½ hours, including marinating
Servings: 6
Category: Main Dish
Ingredients
Chicken & Marinade
- 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1½-inch pieces (chicken breast tenders work well also)
- ½ cup extra-virgin olive oil
- ¼ cup white wine, such as Pinot Grigio
- 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar
- 2 cloves garlic, finely minced
- ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes
- ¼ tsp dried oregano
- 1 tsp kosher salt
- ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
Breadcrumb Coating
- ⅔ cup Italian breadcrumbs
- ⅔ cup panko breadcrumbs
- ½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
- ½ tsp garlic powder
- 1 tsp kosher salt
- ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
- Olive oil cooking spray
Lemon Garlic Butter
- 4 tbsp butter
- 2 cloves garlic, finely minced
- 1 tbsp lemon juice
- 2 tsp fresh parsley, finely chopped
Equipment
- 6 skewers, each 6–8 inches long
- Air fryer
- Instant-read thermometer
Instructions
1. Marinate the Chicken
- Mix the marinade ingredients in a bowl.
- Add the chicken pieces and stir until coated.
- Cover and refrigerate for 30–60 minutes.
2. Bread & Assemble
- Mix the coating ingredients, except the cooking spray, in a shallow dish.
- Lift the chicken out of the marinade and coat it in the breadcrumb mixture. Press the crumbs onto the chicken where needed.
- Divide the chicken among the six skewers, then spray with olive oil cooking spray.
3. Air-Fry
- Preheat the air fryer to 400°F
- Cook the skewers for approximately 12 minutes, until crisp and golden and the chicken reaches 165°F (74°C) internally.
4. Make the Butter & Serve
- While the chicken cooks, microwave the butter and garlic until melted; the recipe suggests about 10 seconds on high.
- Mix in the lemon juice and parsley.
- Spoon the butter sauce over the cooked skewers immediately before serving.
